name: quickjs
description: Run JavaScript inside DuckDB SQL via the embedded QuickJS-NG engine. Modern ES2020 syntax, scalar and table-valued forms, parameter passthrough — for the cases where SQL doesn't have the right primitive and Python is too heavy.

cta.title: JavaScript in Your SELECT
cta.description: Install QuickJS to run snippets and functions written in JavaScript inside DuckDB queries — JSON munging, custom transforms, anything ES2020 can express.
